name: Dan's Drive-In (Montpelier, ID) Rodeo BBQ Bacon Burger (Deep-Fried Onion Warning)
whyItWorks: Deep-fried onion rings inside the burger combine high grease with concentrated allium fructans. Even in mild remission, this can trigger cramping and bloating.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: avoid during active flareups. In stable remission, order with onion rings on the side so you can sample one without eating the entire fried allium stack.
watchOuts: Fried onion rings are high in fructan FODMAPs
